azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppTraces
| where AppRoleName == 'rtp-consumer'
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Message startswith "New GPD message received"
| summarize successCount = count()
| extend totalRequestsString = tostring(successCount)

AppTraces
| where AppRoleName == 'rtp-consumer'
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Message startswith "Error processing message."
| where not (Message contains "rtp/gpd/message")
| summarize errorCount = count()
| extend totalRequestsString = tostring(errorCount)

| extend messageId = tostring(Properties.message_id)
| where isnotempty(messageId)
| summarize uniqueCount = dcount(messageId)
| extend totalRequestsString = tostring(uniqueCount)

AppTraces

| extend messageId = tostring(Properties.message_id)

let _bin = max_of(coalesce(totimespan("$sender_bin_size"), 1h), bin(($__timeTo() - $__timeFrom()) / 19999, 1s) + 1s);
AppTraces
| where AppRoleName == 'rtp-consumer'
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Message startswith "Message processed successfully" or Message startswith "Error processing message."
| extend messageId = tostring(Properties.message_id)
| where isnotempty(messageId)
| make-series
    Successi = dcountif(messageId, Message startswith "Message processed successfully") default = 0,
    Scartati = dcountif(messageId, Message startswith "Error processing message." and not (Message contains "rtp/gpd/message")) default = 0
  on TimeGenerated from bin($__timeFrom(), _bin) to $__timeTo() step _bin
| mv-expand TimeGenerated to typeof(datetime), Successi to typeof(long), Scartati to typeof(long)
| project TimeGenerated, Successi, Scartati
| order by TimeGenerated asc

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let _bin = max_of(coalesce(totimespan("$sender_bin_size"), 1h), bin(($__timeTo() - $__timeFrom()) / 19999, 1s) + 1s);
AppTraces
| where AppRoleName == 'rtp-consumer'
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Message startswith "New GPD message received"
| make-series Ingeriti = count() default = 0 on TimeGenerated from bin($__timeFrom(), _bin) to $__timeTo() step _bin
| mv-expand TimeGenerated to typeof(datetime), Ingeriti to typeof(long)
| project TimeGenerated, Ingeriti
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Messaggi che il Consumer ha ingerito nel tempo

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppTraces
| where AppRoleName == 'rtp-consumer'
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Message startswith "Payload:"
| extend
    msg_id          = extract(@"id=(\d+)", 1, Message),
    operation       = extract(@"operation=(\w+)", 1, Message),
    status          = extract(@"status=([A-Z_]+)", 1, Message),
    ec_tax_code     = extract(@"ec_tax_code=([^,\]]+)", 1, Message),
    debtor_tax_code = extract(@"debtor_tax_code=([^,\]]+)", 1, Message),
    iuv             = extract(@"iuv=([^,\]]+)", 1, Message)
| where isnotempty(msg_id)
| summarize
    ["Consegne EVH"]     = count(),
    ["Prima consegna"]   = min(TimeGenerated),
    ["Ultima consegna"]  = max(TimeGenerated),
    ["Operazione"]       = take_any(operation),
    ["Status GPD"]       = take_any(status),
    ["EC Tax Code"]      = take_any(ec_tax_code),
    ["Debtor Tax Code"]  = take_any(debtor_tax_code),
    ["IUV"]              = take_any(iuv)
    by msg_id
| where ["Consegne EVH"] > 1
| extend ["Debtor Tax Code"] = strcat(
    substring(["Debtor Tax Code"], 0, 3),
    substring("***********", 0, strlen(["Debtor Tax Code"]) - 5),
    substring(["Debtor Tax Code"], strlen(["Debtor Tax Code"]) - 2, 2)
)
| project
    ["Message ID"]      = msg_id,
    ["Consegne EVH"]    = ["Consegne EVH"],
    ["Prima consegna"]  = ["Prima consegna"],
    ["Ultima consegna"] = ["Ultima consegna"],
    ["Operazione"]      = ["Operazione"],
    ["Status GPD"]      = ["Status GPD"],
    ["EC Tax Code"]     = ["EC Tax Code"],
    ["Debtor Tax Code"] = ["Debtor Tax Code"],
    ["IUV"]             = ["IUV"]
| sort by ["Consegne EVH"] desc
| limit 100

panels.title: 🔁 MessageId ricevuti più volte dall'EVH (duplicati di consegna)

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let payloads = AppTraces
| where AppRoleName == 'rtp-consumer'
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Message startswith "Payload:"
| extend
    msg_id = extract(@"id=(\d+)", 1, Message),
    operation = extract(@"operation=(\w+)", 1, Message)
| where isnotempty(msg_id) and isnotempty(operation);
let outcomes = AppTraces
| where AppRoleName == 'rtp-consumer'
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Message startswith "Message processed successfully" or Message startswith "Error processing message."
| where not (Message startswith "Error processing message." and Message contains "rtp/gpd/message")
| extend
    msg_id = tostring(Properties.message_id),
    esito = iff(Message startswith "Message processed successfully", "Successo", "Errore");
payloads
| join kind=inner outcomes on msg_id
| where esito == "Errore"
| summarize ["Messaggi"] = count() by ["Operazione"] = operation
| sort by ["Operazione"] asc

panels.title: ❌ Messaggi falliti per Operazione (CREATE / UPDATE / DELETE)

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let payloads = AppTraces
| where AppRoleName == 'rtp-consumer'
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Message startswith "Payload:"
| where Message contains "operation=CREATE"
| extend
    msg_id          = extract(@"id=(\d+)", 1, Message),
    status          = extract(@"status=([A-Z_]+)", 1, Message),
    ec_tax_code     = extract(@"ec_tax_code=([^,\]]+)", 1, Message),
    debtor_tax_code = extract(@"debtor_tax_code=([^,\]]+)", 1, Message),
    iuv             = extract(@"iuv=([^,\]]+)", 1, Message)
| where isnotempty(msg_id);
let outcomes = AppTraces
| where AppRoleName == 'rtp-consumer'
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Message startswith "Message processed successfully" or Message startswith "Error processing message."
| extend
    msg_id = tostring(Properties.message_id),
    esito  = iff(Message startswith "Message processed successfully", "Successo", "Errore"),
    error_msg = iff(Message startswith "Error", trim(" ", replace_string(Message, "Error processing message.", "")), "");
payloads
| join kind=inner outcomes on msg_id
| where esito == "Errore"
| where not (error_msg contains "rtp/gpd/message")
| project
    ["Data"]            = TimeGenerated1,
    ["Message ID"]      = msg_id,
    ["Status GPD"]      = status,
    ["EC Tax Code"]     = ec_tax_code,
    ["Debtor Tax Code"] = debtor_tax_code,
    ["IUV"]             = iuv,
    ["Errore"]          = error_msg
| sort by ["Data"] desc
| limit 50

AppExceptions
| where AppRoleName == 'rtp-consumer'
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize
    ["Occorrenze"] = count(),
    ["Ultimo messaggio"] = arg_max(TimeGenerated, OuterMessage, OperationId)
    by ["Tipo eccezione"] = ExceptionType
| project
    ["Tipo eccezione"],
    ["Occorrenze"],
    ["Ultimo messaggio"] = OuterMessage,
    ["Ultimo OperationId"] = OperationId
| sort by ["Occorrenze"] desc

let statusLegend = datatable(statusCode: string, description: string)
[
    "200", "OK - Successo",
    "400", "Bad Request",
    "401", "Unauthorized",
    "403", "Forbidden",
    "409", "Conflict - Idempotenza",
    "422", "Unprocessable - Business error",
    "499", "Client closed",
    "503", "Service Unavailable",
    "504", "Gateway Timeout"
];
AzureDiagnostics
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where requestUri_s contains 'rtp/gpd/message'
| where httpMethod_s == "POST"
| summarize count() by statusCode = tostring(toint(httpStatus_d))
| join kind=leftouter statusLegend on statusCode
| project label = strcat(statusCode, " - ", coalesce(description, "Altro")), count_
| evaluate pivot(label, sum(count_))

panels.description: Totale dei messaggi inoltrati con successo dal Consumer al Sender, sommando tutte le operazioni: CREATE + UPDATE + DELETE.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppTraces
| where AppRoleName == 'rtp-consumer'
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Message startswith "Retries exhausted after attempts"
| extend retry_msg_id = extract(@"message_id:\s*(\d+)", 1, Message)
| summarize errorCount = count()
| extend totalRequestsString = tostring(errorCount)

let payloads = AppTraces
| where AppRoleName == 'rtp-consumer'
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Message startswith "Payload:"
| extend
    msg_id          = extract(@"id=(\d+)", 1, Message),
    operation       = extract(@"operation=(\w+)", 1, Message),
    status          = extract(@"status=([A-Z_]+)", 1, Message),
    ec_tax_code     = extract(@"ec_tax_code=([^,\]]+)", 1, Message),
    debtor_tax_code = extract(@"debtor_tax_code=([^,\]]+)", 1, Message),
    iuv             = extract(@"iuv=([^,\]]+)", 1, Message)
| where isnotempty(msg_id);
let retries_exhausted = AppTraces
| where AppRoleName == 'rtp-consumer'
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Message startswith "Retries exhausted after attempts"
| extend
    msg_id   = extract(@"message_id:\s*(\d+)", 1, Message),
    attempts = extract(@"attempts:\s*(\d+)", 1, Message);
let errors = AppTraces
| where AppRoleName == 'rtp-consumer'
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Message startswith "Error providing message to rtp-sender"
| extend
    msg_id    = tostring(Properties.message_id),
    error_msg = extract(@"message='([^']+)'", 1, Message);
retries_exhausted
| join kind=leftouter payloads on msg_id
| join kind=leftouter errors on msg_id
| project
    ["Data"]            = TimeGenerated,
    ["Message ID"]      = msg_id,
    ["Tentativi"]       = attempts,
    ["Operazione"]      = operation,
    ["Status GPD"]      = status,
    ["EC Tax Code"]     = ec_tax_code,
    ["Debtor Tax Code"] = debtor_tax_code,
    ["IUV"]             = iuv,
    ["Errore"]          = error_msg
| sort by ["Data"] desc
| limit 50
